title: My teams
subtitle: A team is a permanent group. For each hackathon its lead draws a lineup from the team.
empty: You are not in a team yet
emptyHint: Create a team and invite the people you take part with.
createHint: You become the team lead and its first member.
createFailed: The team could not be created
renameFailed: The name could not be saved
leadOnly: Only the team lead can do this
readOnlyNotice: You are a member of this team. Its lead invites people, enters hackathons and shapes each lineup.
inviteHint: The invited person accepts the invitation themselves.
inviteFailed: The invitation could not be sent
acceptFailed: The invitation could not be accepted
leaveConfirmBody: You stop seeing the team and drop off every lineup it holds. The lead can invite you again.
leaveFailed: You could not leave the team
removeConfirmBody: They leave the team and drop off every lineup. You can invite them again.
removeFailed: The member could not be removed
eventsEmpty: The team has entered no hackathon yet
enterHint: Only a published hackathon accepts a team. Entering registers nobody.
enterFailed: The team could not enter the hackathon
rosterHint: The people from this team taking part in this hackathon. It may be smaller than the team.
rosterEmpty: Nobody is on this lineup yet
rosterNoLimits: The hackathon sets no team size
rosterFailed: The lineup could not be changed
teamNotRegistered: The team does not count as registered yet
derivedHint: This is derived from what the lineup reported, never stored on its own.
selfReportHint: Registration is what each person reports about themselves. Nothing here is checked against the hackathon's own site.
markHint: Record that this person told you they registered. It writes their own self-report and the audit log names you.
markFailed: The report could not be recorded
notAssignedHint: An administrator has to add this person to the hackathon before they can report a registration.
